notes.title: Online multiplayer now available with Remote Play Together!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Steam just added a new feature called "Remote Play Together" that will allow you to play local games, but online with friends!

You can now try to play the campaign together and still hate each other because of the doomed life shared between the two players, or fight yourselves in the Versus mode, at a safe distance!

You only need 2 things: the game (one person is enough) and a good Internet connection.


[h1]How to play with Remote Play Together?[/h1]

Right click on a friend in your Steam friend list, and pick the "Invite to Remote Play Together" option, it's that easy. You'll be connected through the cloud to the same game, like if you were playing locally together.

However, the Remote Play Together feature is still in beta, and requires to be on the beta channel of Steam updates. 

[h1]How to enable Steam beta?[/h1]

Go to your Steam settings.
In the Account tab, click on "Change" and opt-in for Beta participation. Steam will then restart and you should be good to go! It is also the occasion to see the new Library if you haven't seen it yet.

notes.title: Here they come!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33267682/8196f79922e88ba879958ea791dbb064fc8ecda1.png[/img]
Following popular demand, we made the two antagonists, Anis and Reglisse, playable in the solo mode. But we didn't limited ourselves to that. We wanted a challenge worthy of their deadly powers. So we hardened the game, populated the levels with new enemies and made a new boss just for them. And as you would expect, a new challenge comes with new achievements as well. Are you wondering why they hate candy and flowers so much? Play the new campaign to find out.

The name of the game on Steam was changed to "Citrouille: Sweet Witches" to better match the Nintendo Switch version.

The update also contains plenty of minor bug fixes and small improvements everywhere. Hope you will enjoy it :)

notes.title: Polishing Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33267682/dfccbaffbc5f87f5e279623ce8e7d83d91cfdec9.png[/img]

We've just released an update to address the various minors issues you reported on Citrouille. We're also working on a content update (free), but that one will not come until later.

Here is a detailed list of what we added:

[h1]Difficulty modes[/h1]
You can now choose between 3 difficulty modes:
[list]
[*] The Practice mode let you customize the challenge to your liking. You can set the number of lives you start with, slow the enemies down and disable friendly fire.
[*] The Adventure mode is the normal mode and the one that is recommended to new players.
[*] The Arcade mode is intended for speedrunners and those who want to beat the game without cheat or continue.
[/list]

New achievements have been added for beating the game in Arcade mode.

[h1]Audio[/h1]
We added some more sounds and polished the existing ones. All enemies attacks now have an audio feedback.

[h1]Languages[/h1]
We added translations for the two most requested languages: Brazilian Portuguese and Traditional Chinese.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
We made the boss a little bit more merciful, especially in Coop mode.

[h1]Menu[/h1]
We added a Retry button to the Pause menu. In Adventure and Practice difficulty, it makes you restart from the first level of the current world with your life counter full. In Arcade mode it makes you restart from the beginning.

notes.title: Store Problem
notes.content:
We just noticed that Citrouille can no longer be bought on Steam. The "Add to Cart" button no longer appears on the store page.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenient. We do not know why this is happening. We've already contacted Steam and our publisher and we are doing everything we can to solve this issue as soon as possible.
